_comment: Your deployment plan. Hand-edited here so it follows you across devices instead of living in one browser. The page reads it and does the arithmetic; it never edits this file itself. Set 'fired' on a reserve tranche to the date you actually bought, and add each completed DCA buy to 'done' — the panel only tells you the truth if this is kept current.

dca._startDate: Anchor for the fortnightly schedule. Change it if your first buy was a different day and every later date shifts with it.

done._price: fill in your fill price and the panel will show blended cost and average mNAV paid

reserve._rule: Drawdown is measured from the highest close SINCE startDate, not from an all-time high and not from today. Backed by the 2022-24 backtest: demanding triggers (-35% and worse) left the reserve idle and it ended up deployed later at higher prices.
reserve._backstop: Anything still unfired at this point goes in regardless. This is what stops a reserve turning into a permanent forecast.

tilt._comment: Optional sizing overlay on the CORE tranches only, never on the reserve. Scales a tranche by (median mNAV over the window so far) / (today's mNAV), clamped. Backtested at roughly +1-2% on median return — small, but it improved the worst case in every test, and it enforces judging entries by what you pay per dollar of attributable bitcoin rather than by the share price.
